reviews.author: Nupur Panna
reviews.text:
God sends Angels!!
I met Dr. Aishwarya after a recommendation from my dear friend Dr. Bhagya. Having spoken to her over phone she welcomed me to Chennai to visit her clinic.
In the year 2024 Jan finally I met Dr. Aishwarya in her clinic ASCAS. I was gladly welcomed by energetic young Dr. Aishwarya. Till this time I had already gone through a failed IVF cycle, multiple hystro scopy and DNC and was down with lowness.
Dr. Aishwarya with her abundant and versatile knowledge on her subject persuaded me to go through IVF procedure along with PGT. She found her best contacts - Dr Indumathy and Dr Bharath to help me go through the procedure. Dr Aishwarya meticulously transformed each episode of doubt to episodes of hopefulness. She encouraged us all the time asking us to stay positive.
Dr. Ashwin while conducting my USG every time was so kind and patient , listening and answering all my questions during each scan. Every scan was so done with precision , briefing me about the progress of each step and development which the babies were crossing.

Her staff at ASCAS - Sharmi , Anu , Madhu , Ashwini and Uma always were ready to assist us every time we visited them.  Whether it be scans or medicines , they were ever ever ready.

Words have limitations and can’t describe how special me and my husband felt as a couple whenever we visited ASCAS.

As I look back at the journey and see the resultant - our twins in our hands, I really feel that God does send angels on earth to help us through - Dr Aishwarya and Dr Ashwin are few of them

reviews.author: HrudiSundar Sahoo
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience with Dr. Aishwarya at Accura Speciality Clinic. She took excellent care of my wife throughout the three months of consultation, addressing every concern patiently and professionally. Her guidance made us feel confident and supported. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Sukan Dhiyan
reviews.text:
After trying multiple treatments with various hospitals, meeting Dr. Aishwarya Parthasarathy in ASCAS was truly life-changing—it turned our dream into reality. She is highly professional and skilled, employing cutting-edge techniques, and also incredibly friendly and compassionate. The entire environment is so positive and they celebrated our happiness as their own.

Dr. Aishwarya genuinely empathises with her patients, understanding both their emotional and financial challenges. Also I have to mention the staffs in the clinic are so family to us and provided all the support we needed in this journey.

Words cannot express our gratitude to Dr. Aishwarya and her amazing team for their unwavering support and care.

reviews.author: Shyamsundar PG
reviews.text: Dr. Aishwarya and Dr. Ashwin are blessing in disguise. I would say its such a good team of experts with all sort of facilities in "Accumed Specialty Clinic and Scans". We met Dr Aishwarya few years back and she has been examining my wife and me very well and guided us throughout our journey. We naturally conceived using her guidance and now we are blessed with a baby. Dr Aishwarya and her team takes very good personal care of her patients and I would really suggest "Accumed clinic" to anyone.

reviews.author: Barani dharan
reviews.text:
Dr.Aiswarya was known to us through our closest family member. Unfortunately an year before we had a miscarriage, but she gave an extra hope that she will herself deliver our future one.. Said the same, last year when our conception was confirmed, we had fixed in mind that the baby is going to be delivered by her only ---- even after taking a very big decision to leave a developed city.

We knew from our family experience and our experience that she is keen about the well-being of patient and foetus. Every word from the doctor cleared the element of doubt that was surrounding every checkup.
Special mention to Dr.Ashwin that he took every step to ensure that we understood the foetus and its dynamics.

The effort made by Dr Aishwarya to make us have our baby in hands today resonates the dedication and extra mile of caring in delivering the baby even at midnight which made our entire family feel elated and at the same time built huge respect for her dedication.

And her team of staff in ASCAS --- Uma, Sharmi, Ashwini, Madhu, Anu --- is always close to our heart by their attitude.. They are more than a staff.

What not in ASCAS!!! We should just have Trust on the whole team.
A TREE IS KNOWN BY HER FRUITS, ASCAS IS KNOWN FOR ITS DEDICATION AND TRUST.

reviews.author: shamna mohamed
reviews.text:
It is hard to put into words how much I appreciate Dr.Aishwarya and her incredible team at ASCAS. After struggling for three years to conceive, I was emotionally drained and feeling hopeless. During one particularly visit, I broke down in tears, but Dr.Aishwarya was there with her kind and reassuring words.

Her compassion, understanding, and encouragement gave me the strength to keep going. She reminded me to stay positive and believe in the process, and to my amazement, I conceived in the very next cycle. Her guidance and unwavering support truly changed my life.

Her husband, Dr. Ashwin also played a vital role. His expertise and calming demeanor during scans and procedures made me feel at ease every step of the way.

The clinic staff nurses
Anu,uma,Sharmi,Deepti, madhu  deserves just as much praise—they are warm, attentive, and always ready to assist. Their collective dedication creates a welcoming and supportive environment that I will never forget.

And Though this may seem like a small thing, every time Dr.Aishwarya enters the hospital, she greets the patients waiting in the reception with a cheerful smile before heading to her room. I found this so surprising because most doctors don’t usually do that. It’s a small gesture, but it speaks volumes about her kindness and respect for her patients.

If you’re looking for a clinic that combines medical excellence with genuine care and empathy, ASCAS is the place. I am  grateful to Dr.Aishwarya  and her team for helping me achieve what once felt impossible.

reviews.author: VJENTERPRISES v
reviews.text: We Vijay and Abisha .We delivered our boy baby here on 28th March. Before that, In 2 years we gone for many hospitals but its not worked for us .we got 3 abortions in those years. So we finally get to know about the accumed speciality clinic and scans hospital and there the Doctor Aishwarya mam. She gave hope and well treatment for my wife to deliver a healthy baby..we fully satisfied for their work and care.

reviews.author: nitin kumar
reviews.text:
Dear Dr. Aishwarya Parthasarathy,
Words can't fully express how grateful I am for your expertise and support during the procedure. Your calmness and swift decisions made all the difference in what was a very challenging time. I will forever be thankful for your skill and kindness nature. 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.author: Punitha aruldhas
reviews.text:
I wanted to express my heartfelt gratitude for your exceptional care during my pregnancy and delivery. When my baby passed meconium and your expertise and calm demeanor helped a normal delivery by God's grace, we are blessed with a baby boy.
Your professionalism and guidance made a significant difference in my experience.
Thank you for everything Dr.Aishwarya mam & ASCAS team.

reviews.author: Vipul Horo
reviews.text:
Dr. Aishwarya, Dr. Ashwin and the entire staff of ASCAS has been an amazing companion throughout our pregnancy journey. They have stood by us and have guided us through the ups and downs for the past year. They have been available at anytime over the phone and incase of any emergency. The help and support extends outside the clinic as well.

I still remember Dr. Aishwarya saying "Don't worry. We will send you with a baby". And here we are with not just one but two of them.

In the past one year we have seen her clinic grow as well, the infrastructure, more facilities and even more happy patients. I wish and pray to God that their staff and clinic prosper, which I'm sure that it would because of their tremendous hardwork and excellent knowledge in the field.

More than anything it's the human touch that is so overwhelming. Together they are bringing so much joy for all their patients. In them we just don't have a brilliant doctors but also amazing friends for life.

God bless them all.
